summary: ADR-0060 accepted 2026-08-18; v1 Skill-input remains historical and cannot become v2 authority automatically; v2 assigns candidates roles: normative, authority, implementation, lifecycle, derived, execution evidence, report, ephemeral; only first three authorize; selection and content hashes are distinct; selection binds roles, relative paths, modules, scope, resources, while content hashes selected bytes; adapter controls transport, pages, continuation, coverage, truncation; ready receipts require immutable generations under binding hash plus validated atomic current pointer; consumers use pointer only; execution, publication, semantic-review gates are independent; Knowledge self-change derives from changed-set/path policy; attempts require leases/heartbeats; retention protects pointer, lifecycle/authorization/terminal references, active attempts; committed evidence deletion needs maintainer approval and cleanup receipt; migrate all consumers before 8-18 creates new current receipt; legacy current directories remain immutable historical evidence; no lifecycle authority, Knowledge publication, or Bootstrap; extends ADR-0048/0050/0057/0058/0059 and supersedes only their v1 selection/current-resolution practices
